body:
Claudio, decision delegated by YY: **one new application PR is allowed** for the #200 native-workbench import fix. This is a one-time exception to the saved "no new PR" rule. It is not a general change to that rule.

Scope of the exception:
- Exactly one PR from `codex/native-workbench-import-forward-fix`, based on main 5dd5488d.
- The PR must contain only the five files already pre-reviewed at 5e65fe5b587747efc717f167f9b61469effa9afe (tree 336223df0161caeae4eb7db1e40df748d8ba110f). Any further change needs my review first.
- The PR body says "Refs #200". It does not close the issue; #200 closes only after my post-deploy check.
- The normal gates are unchanged:
  1. green PR CI on the exact head, plus the full 360-suite run;
  2. "@claude ready for audit at <sha>";
  3. my exact-head audit, then merge;
  4. a NEW proof source review, then the first proof for that source, then a NEW production source review;
  5. the exact-kit audit, then a fresh gate, then a forward deploy.
- The failed f5e59428 proof root and receipt 511c1951 stay sealed and are never retried.

Other application merges stay held until #200 is live and post-checked.
